retrieval.note: lexical and hybrid run Store.recall verbatim; hybrid_cites runs Brain.runTurn verbatim; vector is a harness-side pure-cosine ranker over the same stored vectors

grading.oracle: lowercased substring mustAll / mustAny / mustNot over the answer text
grading.citations: every cited short id must appear in the recalled set
grading.updates: new value must be retrieved and the superseded value must stay out
grading.limitation: substring oracles can miss correct rephrasings — see eval/README.md before quoting
